book.name: 2 TESALONICENSES
book.title: U KAꞌBꞌ Uꞌ ITZꞌIBꞌA BꞌEN U PABLO XEꞌ QꞌU NIMAN TETZ U JESUUSTU TESALOONICA Ikaꞌv uꞌuj uvaꞌ itzꞌibꞌa bꞌen u Pablo te unqꞌa aa Tesalónica uvaꞌ ni niman u Jesús

content: Ni tal u Pablo uvaꞌ aꞌ viyol u Tiixheꞌ la oksal iqꞌii
Vitzꞌin vatzik, enachtaj Tiixh sqiꞌ, aqꞌal uvaꞌ la pax veꞌt viyol u Kubꞌaaleꞌ tulaj unqꞌa tenameꞌ. As la oksal veꞌt iqꞌii, echeꞌ uvaꞌ kat ibꞌan sexoꞌl.

As enachtaj Tiixh sqiꞌ, aqꞌal uvaꞌ la eesal el tzan oꞌ vatz unqꞌa bꞌanol vaꞌlexheꞌ tukꞌ unqꞌa bꞌanol txꞌiꞌla aamaileꞌ tan jit chit kajayil unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ ni niman u chusbꞌaleꞌ uvaꞌ tetz u Tiixheꞌ.
As jik chiteꞌ u Kubꞌaaleꞌ. As Aakeꞌ la yakꞌinsan vetaanxelaleꞌ. As la ikol ex Aak vatz u vaꞌlexheꞌ.
As kꞌujleꞌl kukꞌuꞌl setiꞌ, tan tiꞌ uvaꞌ at veꞌt ok ex kꞌatz u Kubꞌaaleꞌ. As ootzimaleꞌ sqaꞌn uvaꞌ nebꞌaneꞌ kam uveꞌ kat qal sete. As echat kuxh tuk ebꞌaneꞌ tiꞌ ibꞌeneꞌ.

As aꞌ u Kubꞌaaleꞌ la yakꞌinsan vetaanxelaleꞌ, tan tiꞌ uvaꞌ xoꞌn veꞌt ex te u Tiixheꞌ as xoꞌn veꞌt u Tiixheꞌ sete. As la iyakꞌinsa veꞌt Aak vetaanxelaleꞌ, aqꞌal uvaꞌ la ekuy u kꞌaxkꞌoeꞌ echeꞌ uvaꞌ kat ibꞌan u Cristo tan kat ikuy Aak u kꞌaxkꞌoeꞌ.
Ni tal u Pablo uvaꞌ yeꞌ la iyaꞌsa unqꞌa niman tetz u Jesús ibꞌanat u aqꞌoneꞌ
As tukꞌ vibꞌii u Kubꞌaal Jesucristo tuk qal bꞌen sete uvaꞌ la eteesa etibꞌ kꞌatz unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ uveꞌ vaꞌlexh kuxh vitxumbꞌaleꞌ. As yeꞌ nibꞌaneꞌ kam uvaꞌ kat kuchus kan sete.
As ootzimaleꞌ setaꞌn uvaꞌ bꞌaꞌneꞌ uvaꞌ ech la ebꞌaneꞌ echeꞌ uvaꞌ nik kubꞌan sexoꞌl, tan yeꞌl oꞌ uvaꞌ vaꞌlexh koj qatineꞌ tukꞌ u kutxumbꞌaleꞌ kat kubꞌan sexoꞌl.
As yeꞌl oꞌ uvaꞌ kat kuxh koj txꞌaꞌn oꞌ tul yeꞌ kat kuchooa. Pet kat aqꞌonvu oꞌ sqꞌiil aqꞌbꞌal tukꞌ koolichil, tan aꞌ nik qaleꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌ la qaqꞌ etaqꞌon tiꞌ etaqꞌat kutxꞌix.
As yeꞌle uvaꞌ yeꞌ koj la uch etaqꞌat qechbꞌubꞌal. Pet aꞌ nik qaleꞌ uvaꞌ la ebꞌan etetz echeꞌ uveꞌ nik kubꞌaneꞌ. As estiꞌeꞌ kat aqꞌonvu oꞌ sexoꞌl.
As tul uvaꞌ atik oꞌ sexoꞌl, as kat kukꞌujbꞌaꞌ kan umaꞌl u yol uvaꞌ ech ni tal ileꞌ: «Asoj at umaj uxhchil uvaꞌ yeꞌ nisaꞌ aqꞌon, as yeꞌl itxꞌix la aqꞌpi.»
As ni qabꞌi yol uvaꞌ at uxhchil sexoꞌl uvaꞌ vaꞌlexh kuxh tatineꞌ tukꞌ vitxumbꞌaleꞌ. As yeꞌ ni taqꞌonveꞌ. Pet nu kuxh toksa tibꞌ xoꞌl unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ tiꞌ unqꞌa yoleꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌl tetz stiꞌ.
As abꞌil uveꞌ ech nibꞌaneꞌ as tukꞌ vibꞌii u Kubꞌaal Jesucristo ni qalkat bꞌen tiꞌ kubꞌeyat ste uvaꞌ la aqꞌonvi tijikil tiꞌ itxꞌakat ijaꞌmil vitxꞌixeꞌ.
As yeꞌ la yaꞌ ex, vitzꞌin vatzik, tiꞌ ebꞌanat u bꞌaꞌneꞌ.
Pet asoj at umaj uxhchil uvaꞌ yeꞌ la niman uveꞌ ni qal bꞌen tu uꞌujeꞌ, as la etal xoꞌl unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ. As yeꞌ la uch emolot etibꞌ stukꞌ, aqꞌal uvaꞌ la chꞌixvu veꞌteꞌ tiꞌ uveꞌ nibꞌaneꞌ.
As chꞌoꞌniꞌk etaama stiꞌ, pet la ebꞌeya ste tan titzꞌin etatzik etibꞌ stukꞌ kꞌatz u Kubꞌaaleꞌ.
Nitzojpu veꞌt iyolon u Pablo te unqꞌa aa Tesalónica
As aꞌ u Kubꞌaaleꞌ ni bꞌanon uvaꞌ bꞌaꞌn etatin sevatzaj. As Aakeꞌ la aqꞌon sete tiꞌ chit ibꞌeneꞌ. As Aakeꞌ la kaa veꞌt sexoꞌl sekajayil.
As ineꞌ in Pablo nuntzꞌibꞌa bꞌen unqꞌa yoleꞌ sete tukꞌ unqꞌabꞌ tiꞌ unqꞌiilat bꞌen ex. As aꞌ kꞌuchbꞌal tetzeꞌ uvaꞌ in tzꞌibꞌan bꞌen tetz sete, tan ech untzꞌibꞌeꞌ tul nuntzꞌibꞌeꞌ.
As aꞌ vibꞌaꞌnil u Kubꞌaal Jesucristo la kaa veꞌt setiꞌaj sekajayil. An chiteꞌ.
